summary: The presentation theorem is new, but the PR adds a second copy of the SAGBI sufficiency machinery already in `SAGBI/Criterion.lean` (lifting a toric component through the binomials, weight homogeneity of binomials, descent on the top weight, the toric criterion for a weight component) instead of sharing one copy. It also rebuilds the existing `IsWeightedHomogeneous.weightedHomogeneousComponent_mul_right` by hand.
